name: Charlotte County, FL
findings: Charlotte County has 494 nonprofit organizations. 215 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 169 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Charlotte County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 43 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.text: 3 economic development organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Charlotte County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
